method: Each lot cites a page opened in this session (25 searches, 40 fetches, both exhausted). vf: V = the house’s own result page or press release; S = trade or general press; U = unconfirmed or a last-resort page (the Wikipedia list, read on its wikiwand mirror because en.wikipedia.org was not fetchable). Prices are with fees in US$m unless stated. price_usd_m_confirmed is null where the page states a different figure, even by rounding; the page’s figure is then in page_price and the note says whether the difference is rounding or a real discrepancy. Hammer and estimate only where the page states them; local-currency figures are in the note where the sale was not in US$. Buyers only as the page words them. Pages that refused: christies.com.cn /en/stories (bot check, twice), artprice.com, scmp.com, artnews.com, businessinsider.nl, en.wikipedia.org (not on the allowlist).
